Unbelievably great! Must visit
Oct 2026 • Business
I was born and raised in Italy and have been living in the United States since 2013. In all these years, I can honestly say that I have never found an Italian restaurant in America that feels as authentic as Pane e Vino.

The food is absolutely exceptional. Every dish tastes genuinely Italian, and you can immediately tell that the ingredients are of the highest quality. But what makes this place truly special goes far beyond the food.

The atmosphere is wonderful. It feels like stepping into a beautiful Italian country home, warm, welcoming, intimate, and full of character. The service is outstanding, and the kindness, friendliness, and genuine hospitality of the staff and the owner are simply priceless.

As an Italian, this is the kind of place that makes me feel at home. If you want to experience what it feels like to sit around the table with a real Italian family, enjoying fantastic food and genuine hospitality, go to Pane e Vino.

Without question, one of the best and most authentic Italian dining experiences I have had outside of Italy. Five stars are not enough.

Charming, intimate, lively, delicious—and unmistakably Authentic Hospitality
Sep 2026 • Family
THE BEST DATE-NIGHT ROMANTIC SPOT IN MIAMI. But also great for friends and family.!

Pane y Vino is one of those rare restaurants that gets everything right: charming, delicious, romantic, and completely unique. The décor has so much personality, and the entire experience feels wonderfully old-school—from the attentive service to the little details that make you feel genuinely taken care of.

The owner is lively, charismatic, and absolutely charming, faithfully tending to her guests and making the whole room feel warm and personal.

And then there’s the food.

The carpaccio was exceptional: paper-thin slices of fresh beef topped with delicately sliced mushrooms and a unique lemon crème that made the whole dish sing. The mussels were enormous, served in a spicy tomato broth so delicious you’ll want to finish it with a spoon.

Just when you think it can’t get any better, dessert arrives. Homemade, gourmet, and prepared right at your table—and somehow it doesn’t feel gimmicky at all. It’s genuinely spectacular. The surprise hint of Nutella hidden beneath the delicate finger cookies takes it completely over the top.

And if you love eggplant parmigiana, theirs is top of the line.

The portions are hearty, the prices are surprisingly reasonable for the quality and experience, and the atmosphere is made for a romantic night out.

One warning: make your reservation in advance. Pane y Vino gets packed, and once you experience it, you’ll understand why.

Pane e Vino - one of the top reasons I love Miami!
Aug 2026 • Friends
I am not a local, however Pan e Vino is a must stop when I am in Miami. I've been going there for years now and am already hungry thinking about my next trip. All pasta is made on site - you can watch them making it in their front window. My favorite is the Tonnarelli alla Ruota. They bring out a BIG wheel of parmesan, carve out some of the cheese and then pour in hot pasta and sauce and swirl it all around the cheese. It's just magnificent! And save room for table prepared tiramisu -- that's right -- not a pre-made square. They pour espresso over the lady fingers and then generally add mascarpone cheese. Definitely save room!

You will probably see the owner, Athena, while you are there. She is such a lovely host and that's a big part of the reason I keep returning. Special shout out to Pedro who was our server on my last visit. He was super friendly and a joy to be with.

One last tip -- make a reservation....this place is small (but mighty)!
